---------------------------------------------------------------------
"Our society tends to regard as a 'sickness' any mode of thought or
behavior that is inconvenient for the system, and this is plausible
because when an individual doesn't fit into the system it causes pain
to the individual as well as problems for the system.  Thus the
manipulation of an individual to adjust him to the system is seen as
a 'cure' for a 'sickness' and therefore as good."
-- The Unabomber Manifesto; Paragraph 155
